## Real analysis

### MIT 18.100B — Real Analysis

- **Level:** Advanced undergraduate
- **Purpose:** Mathematical maturity, proof-writing, rigorous analysis
- **Format:** Video lectures, lecture notes, problem sets
- **Language:** English
- **Programme status:** Optional
- **Best used:** Before or alongside advanced optimisation, theoretical game theory, statistical learning theory, or theoretical machine learning

- [MIT OpenCourseWare course page](https://ocw.mit.edu/courses/18-100b-real-analysis-spring-2025/)
- [MIT video lecture playlist](https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLUl4u3cNGP62Ie7F_tTAhhXoX5_Cl8meG)
